# The ici pack

*ICI* · version 1.0.0 · code `ICIX`

## What it is

ICI is a generic cross-asset booking system. What it trades was not stated, so it is MOCKED as a generic cross-asset booking system (rates, FX, equity, credit and commodity tickets; UPPER_SNAKE names, sections HEADER, INSTRUMENT, PARTIES, DATES; YYYYMMDD dates).
The data is **mocked**: a synthetic look-alike written by `tools/samplegen/src_ici.py` (never real data, banks or counterparties), a few hundred trades over sixty business days in the system's own native style, with no positions and no scenario P&L, so the VaR does not move.

**ICI is mocked as a generic cross-asset booking system**: the owner did not say what it trades, so the mock books rates, FX, equity, credit and commodity tickets from one blotter.

This pack is one source of the canonical `trade` kind: its rows carry `SOURCE_SYSTEM = ICI`. It is a pack of the `trading-systems` module that
extends `trading`; switch it on or off in Admin -> Artifacts (the pack is the switch).

## Data structures

Every kind the pack owns, read from its manifest, its samples and its Sutras: how its ids look, its fields (type, an example, what it means), its nested lists and the fields that link to other kinds. A path `A[].B` is field `B` of every element of list `A`.

## Enabling and dependencies

Builds on the packs `trading`.

The connectors it brings (written once to `config/connectors/<name>.yaml`, then the site's own):

| Connector | Plugin | Kinds | Enabled |
|---|---|---|---|
| `trade-ici` | `delta` | `trade` | `${DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED:true}` |
| `trade-ici-live` | `kafka` | `trade` | `${DRISHTI_STREAM_ICI:false}` |

Settings (environment variables) its connectors read: `DRISHTI_ICI_TOPIC`, `DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED`, `DRISHTI_STREAM_ICI`, `DRISHTI_STREAM_STALE_AFTER`.
